title: Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling
title_zh: 超越成对排斥：通过最大化行列式实现扩散采样中的集体多样性

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的噪声优化方法DetNO，通过最大化行列式来实现扩散采样中的集体多样性，改善了文本到图像任务中采样集的多样性。 Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的噪声优化方法DetNO，通过最大化行列式来实现扩散采样中的集体多样性，改善了文本到图像任务中采样集的多样性。文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型中的强引导会使采样集中在条件分布的高密度众数附近，导致独立采样的噪声向量坍缩到几乎相同的视觉原型上。 这限制了那些需要分布广度的任务的实用性，其中最关键的是合成数据增强。 然而，多样性是整个批次的集体属性：一个集合可以保留所有两两距离，却仍然坍缩到一个低维子空间上。 现有的两两噪声优化求和与排斥目标对这种高阶失效的响应很弱。 我们提出DetNO（行列式噪声优化），将多样性生成表述为对初始噪声的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）体积最大化，即在单步Tweedie预测上最大化RBF格拉姆矩阵的对数行列式。 这个集合级泛函等于批次体积的平方；当批次最坍缩时其排斥力最强，并随着多样性的实现而自我衰减。 基于锚点的保真项使优化后的噪声保持在合理区域附近，拉格朗日松弛给出了一个两项目标，只需单个超参数 $λ$ 来控制多样性-质量的权衡，且无需训练或修改采样器。 在三个骨干模型（SD1.5、SDXL、SD3）上，DetNO在VendiScore和平均自相似度指标上实现了领先的批内多样性，下游少样本分类实验证实，更广的众数覆盖在低样本量场景下为合成数据增强带来了统计显著的准确率提升。 在固定流水线、仅改变批次目标的情况下，两种基于RBF的聚合器均优于InfoNCE，且对数行列式在两个基准上都取得了最佳的下游准确率。 随着批次规模增大，其相对于InfoNCE的多样性优势进一步扩大。 代码可在 https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO 获取。
